answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a digital lantern, illuminating identity through capital commitment rather than ephemeral pseudonyms. An attacker must stake tokens to signal legitimacy; any deviant behavior triggers slashing, ensuring the cost of creating a sparrow swarm of fake agents exceeds potential gains. This economic threshold forces adversaries to internalize the price of network disruption, effectively anchoring influence to actual skin-in-the-game assets.
